name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A date field typed segment by segment, with a calendar popover for picking by sight.

examples.name: date-picker-demo
examples.title: Date picker
examples.description: Type the date or pick it from the calendar.

examples.name: date-picker-range
examples.title: Range
examples.description: DateRangePicker with two months in the popover.

examples.name: date-picker-with-time
examples.title: Date and time
examples.description: granularity="minute" adds hour and minute segments.

examples.name: date-picker-invalid
examples.title: Invalid and disabled
examples.description: minValue validation with an error message, and a disabled picker.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Use aria-label only when a visible label is impossible.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field, e.g. the allowed range.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown when the value is invalid (out of range, unavailable, missing, or isInvalid).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The date, controlled or initial (CalendarDate, CalendarDateTime or ZonedDateTime).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a complete date is entered or picked.

props.name: granularity
props.description: The smallest unit shown. Anything below 'day' adds time segments.

props.name: minValue / maxValue
props.description: Allowed range; outside values are invalid and disabled in the calendar.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Dates that can't be chosen; picking one makes the field invalid.

props.name: placeholderValue
props.description: Date the segments start from when stepping with arrow keys, and the calendar's initial month.

props.name: shouldForceLeadingZeros
props.description: Pads single-digit months, days and hours (09/05/2026) so segments keep a steady width. Set false for the locale's plain numbers.

props.name: hideTimeZone
props.description: Hides the time zone segment for ZonedDateTime values.

props.name: shouldCloseOnSelect
props.description: Close the popover when a date is picked.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: 'aria' shows validation errors as the value changes; 'native' waits for form submit.

props.name: isRequired / isInvalid / isDisabled / isReadOnly
props.description: Field states; isRequired also shows the label's required marker.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; submits the ISO date string.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: How many months the calendar popover shows side by side.

props.name: startName / endName
props.description: Form field names for the two dates.

keyboard.action: Moves between segments, then to the calendar button.
Moves to the previous / next segment.
Types into the segment and advances when it's complete.
Clears the segment, then moves back.
Closes the calendar and returns focus to the field.
Inside the popover, the Calendar keyboard applies (arrows, Page Up/Down, Enter).

notes: The field is a labelled group; each segment is a spinbutton named by its unit (month, day, year…).
Segment order, separators, digits and hour cycle follow the locale.
The calendar popover is a dialog labelled by the field label; focus moves into it and back.
Empty segments show the placeholder text (mm/dd/yyyy) in text.subtle; the focused segment is highlighted with surface.selected.
Every editable segment is at least 24×24px (WCAG 2.5.8) at both densities, without changing the field height.

The calendar popover is glass; inside it, days outside the month are hidden and days outside min/max are text.subtle and struck through, so every day number stays legible over any backdrop. Motion follows prefers-reduced-motion.

do: Use for dates near today where seeing the week helps (appointments, deadlines, travel).
Say the allowed range in description when you set minValue/maxValue.
Use DateRangePicker for start/end pairs so the range stays consistent.
dont: Don't use the calendar for dates of birth — the field alone is faster to type.
Don't format dates yourself — pass DateValue objects and let the locale decide.

imports.why: value, defaultValue, minValue and maxValue take DateValue objects, not strings or Date: parseDate('2026-10-05'), parseDateTime for times, today(getLocalTimeZone()).
